rows.concrete_observation: DamageSources static subscriber owns UUID->serverTick map. ignoreNextKnockback only when target has server: opportunistically removes all entries age>=10 then replaces target tick. LivingKnockBackEvent handler checks same UUID and server, cancels if currentServerTick-stored<=1, then removes entry regardless expired/not-canceled. Thus a one-use short lease, not permanent resistance or status admission. No lower-bound age check, no server-instance/dimension discriminator, no per-hit source token; no periodic cleanup besides next producer. Generic applyDamage with Living+SpellDamageSource posts SpellDamageEvent first, cancellation returnsfalse before lease; then adjusts school resistance. Direct NoKnockbackProjectile arms lease BEFORE living-attacker friendlyfire check and target.hurt. Friendlyfire false-return or hurtfalse need not consume lease immediately; unrelated target knockback within window can consume it. Marker alone is0, actual subscriber and native production consumer both read. Concrete EarthquakeAoe applyEffect manually arms target then native target.hurt(damageSource,getDamage), on true attempts MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN and unconditionally addsY0.5 to existing velocity/hurtMarked without inspecting addEffect return. This is native combat knockback suppression followed by distinct spell lift on accepted hurt, not victim immunity to all displacement. AoeEntity server tick, delay/duration and reapply checkHits provide real call chain: owner/allied rejection plus super projectile eligibility, circular radius; earthquake override admits all ground contexts and expandsY5. checkHits sets hittrue after applyEffect returnsvoid even when hurtfalse, so radius/duration-on-use semantics mean eligibility, not damage success. No Boss type-tag no-lift filter seen in this chain.
